verify.evidence_scope: WarmQuant was submitted and confirmed through native CUA on 2026-10-09. This reusable recipe has only offline validation; no live CLI, extension or CDP submission has been tested.
verify.editorial_required_fields: Message and Link are optional in the site's HTML but required by this recipe for a meaningful product request. Tag is required by the site; its internal email field is category text, not a contact email.
limitations: Only submit appropriate AI tools with an accurate description and first product category. A receipt confirms intake, not editorial approval.
The current engine has no optional popup-dismiss step. Close blocking newsletter popups through human or computer use before continuing; no mandatory dismissal selector is included.
All fields, final submit and receipt are scoped to the exact product form. There is no global success-text fallback because other forms can display the same message.
Public WordPress search may omit custom tool records or private pending submissions; a missing result is not an exhaustive duplicate check.
